author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
It's PART ONE of the Terror on Devlan JOINT OPERATIONS as the Spectre Squad of Astra Militarum troopers hot-drop into a desperate evacuation zone to hunt a terrifying threat. Surrounded on all sides in their LZ they must make a mad-dash to the spaceport to regroup and begin their search for the insidious Xenoform code-named 'The Red Terror'.

Download the Terror on Devlan Joint Ops rules FREE: https://assets.warhammer-community.com/eng_terror_on_devlan_mission_pack-xxesbxnr8b-lyb0mbmtbe.pdf

Thanks to Games Workshop for the complimentary advance copy of the box to review.
